name: Glazed facade 150
about: A glazed outside wall (a curtain wall or window wall), 150 thick with its framing, from the floor up to the slab above (or the height you give it): the daylight side of an office floor. It counts as the outside for rooms that need a window only where a window stands in it. Since R144 its height is set by the project's relationships (the storey less the slab and beams above it); with none set, it reaches its full rise.
